name: photo-refiner-studio
description: Interactive Photo Refiner v2.3 settings and creative translation for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Value-aware photo refinement with a simplified creative control surface
interface.longDescription: Configure Photo Refiner v2.3 through a simplified creative workspace before generation. The default surface focuses on look, delivery, and output while adaptive high-resolution recovery stays automatic. After choosing a style preset, Starryear is an optional second creative stage that defaults to one complete effect image; professional mode adds portrait, clothing, landscape, and batch controls.
